column1: # name <TAB> seeds (comma separated) <TAB> output dir <TAB> toc regex <TAB>
# max pages per run <TAB> delay seconds
# The crawler starts at the seeds, and follows links only into the "book"
# folders that the table-of-contents pages themselves point at, so a library
# mirror can be crawled one documentation set at a time.  Tables of contents
# are always allowed and are stored as well.  An entry with a wrong number of
# fields is reported and ignored (it is never crawled silently).
# datadungeon-ce: the Windows CE documentation of the MSDN Library April 2000
# (CE 2.12/3.0 era) on library.thedatadungeon.com.  Its robots.txt disallows
# AI-training crawlers only; this is a documentation archive with an ordinary
# user agent, one request at a time, 2.5 s apart (~24 pages/minute, so a run
# of 600 pages takes about 25 minutes and the whole tree a few runs).
